name: SellerClaw
description:
SellerClaw connects Claude to your e-commerce stack so you can run day-to-day store operations in conversation. Once connected, Claude works with your Amazon, eBay, Shopify, Meta Ads, and other linked accounts through your SellerClaw workspace.

What you can do:

- Look up products, orders, inventory, and pricing across every connected marketplace
- Draft and publish listings — titles, bullets, descriptions, and channel-specific attributes
- Review ad campaign performance and adjust budgets, bids, and targeting
- Research suppliers and source new products
- Update stock levels and prices in bulk
- Pull sales, margin, and account-health reports

SellerClaw exposes your integrations as a small set of grouped actions rather than hundreds of individual tools: Claude lists the available groups, inspects what a group does, then runs the specific action you asked for. This keeps the connector responsive no matter how many stores and channels you have attached, and means new integrations become available without changing the connector.

You control which accounts SellerClaw can reach and which operations require your sign-off before they run — useful for anything touching live listings, ad spend, or customer orders.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SellerClaw to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SellerClaw to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.sellerclaw.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SellerClaw MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SellerClaw provides these MCP tools: sellerclaw_describe, sellerclaw_groups, sellerclaw_guide, and sellerclaw_run.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SellerClaw?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SellerClaw in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
SellerClaw requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SellerClaw is developed by SellerAI, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
